description: This is a Dart source file implementing a Flutter application that loads local HTML assets into WebView and navigates between routes. It defines the main app widget, route handling, and webview rendering.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application that sets up route mapping and initial screen.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Provides a list view of all route screens for navigation.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Wraps an HTML asset within a scaffold with AppBar.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Stateful widget that loads and displays a local HTML asset in WebView.

classes.name: _HtmlAssetWebViewState
classes.description: State associated with HtmlAssetWebView, handles loading, injecting base href, and WebView control.

classes.name: _ErrorView
classes.description: Displays error message if HTML loading fails.

methods.name: MyApp.build
methods.description: Builds the root MaterialApp and defines route generation logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes Flutter binding and runs the app.

methods.name: ScreensIndex.build
methods.description: Builds a list of route tiles for navigation.

methods.name: HtmlAssetScreen.build
methods.description: Builds scaffold containing WebView for HTML asset.

methods.name: _HtmlAssetWebViewState.initState
methods.description: Initializes WebViewController and loads HTML content.

methods.name: _HtmlAssetWebViewState._loadHtml
methods.description: Loads HTML file from assets, injects base href, encodes as data URI, and loads into WebView.

methods.name: _HtmlAssetWebViewState._injectBaseHref
methods.description: Processes raw HTML to insert base href and normalize resource paths.
